facts.text: Knollwood sits just two miles north of Sherman, accessible via Farm Road 131, placing it firmly in north‑central Grayson County.
The city borders Sherman to the south, the county seat of Grayson County, giving it a close relationship with the regional hub.
Knollwood is part of the Sherman–Denison metropolitan statistical area, linking it to one of Texas’s growing suburban regions.
As a city in Texas, Knollwood shares the state’s rich ranching and oil‑history heritage, though it remains a small, tight‑knit community.
Knollwood is officially recognized as a city within the United States, reflecting its incorporation status.
Residents of Knollwood rely on the town hall for construction permits and code enforcement, reflecting the city’s local governance structure.
